scope: Read-only report on existing evidence. Dry runs use deterministic first rows of already-opened old cohorts, not the new phone validation/test cohort. No raw vectors, packets or private identities are published.

phone_augmentation.resampling_scope: Exact repetition of real recorded training rows; not synthetic features or independent new sessions.
phone_augmentation.scope: One phone and lab app, chronological sessions/held-out forms; not independent device/day/site generalization.

software_fixture.scope: Hand-constructed coherent software input only; no accuracy label, training use, phone traffic or dataset row.
